text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's not catching up! She's not going 
to make it!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa bravely challenged Silence 
Suzuka, but she's losing steam—!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... *wheeze, wheeze*...

El Condor Pasa pursued with every ounce of 
her strength. Even so, the back of the 
"Silence of Another Dimension" remained 
far out of reach.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My legs... my arms... my breathing... 
*wheeze*... *urp*...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So this is... El's...
(Thud)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El!? Eeel-!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, call an ambulance!
(Wee-woo wee-woo!)

The results of the detailed examination 
showed nothing serious. Even so...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's impossible... desu...
choice_data_list: Huh, what do you mean impossible?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El gave it everything... Body, soul, every 
single part of me, just to beat 
Suzuka-senpai...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yet even going all out, pushing to the 
max, and pouring in everything Trainer and 
I worked for, I still fell short...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right now, El is... falling apart... A 
condor with broken wings.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And the Japan Cup... If world-class 
powerhouses even greater than 
Suzuka-senpai are going to descend upon 
us..."

Her shoulders slump in defeat. The pride 
she'd maintained with all her might had 
reached its limit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I... admit it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El isn't... the strongest in the world...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"This race made El realize. El still 
has... a long way to go..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"With my current strength... the Japan Cup 
is impossible, yes..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I can't... anymore...

Taking in El Condor Pasa's words of 
despair— I'll wipe the slate clean for 
this year's plan for now.

"Conquering the Japan Cup in the Classic 
year." The grand dream held high toward 
the sky—plummeted, unfulfilled.
